text: Coffee with Petra and Ahmed. Petra's moved to Leeds, works at the uni library now. Ahmed's still at the garage, three days a week. Their daughter starts Year 7 in September. Petra's taken up sea swimming too, goes out at Scarborough most weekends even in the cold. Ahmed thinks she's mad. They're both coming down for Christmas, arriving December 22 in the afternoon.
Victor's birthday is June 3rd. He's mad into vinyl at the moment, mostly old jazz pressings. Ann reckons a record cleaning kit would go down well.

Long call with Chloe. Her brother Louis is doing the Great North Run on September 13 and is already panicking about it. She's flying out to see their gran in Porto the week after. I should text Louis good luck the night before.
Abdi lives in Walthamstow now, just off the market. Works nights as a paramedic. His wife Sana teaches maths at the girls' school.
Alfie's into Warhammer in a big way, painting a whole Space Marine army. His mum says his birthday's 11/2 and he's been dropping hints about a proper airbrush.
Siddharth and Kavya are doing their anniversary dinner Saturday at 7. Ten years! Need to send flowers to theirs Saturday morning.

Caught up with Isaac after five a side. He supports Spurs, season ticket for twenty years, sits with his dad. Dad's just had a hip replacement, back home since Monday. Don't forget to ask Isaac how his dad's getting on.
Jess knits. Like, seriously knits, she's done a whole Fair Isle jumper. Lives in Hebden Bridge with her partner Aleksander and two cats.
Oscar's party on the 12th at half 8 is off, he's got covid. Rescheduled to sometime in November apparently.
Kerry works in HR at the council, been there eleven years. Lives with her sister Deepa in a flat above the chippy. Deepa's the one who does the pottery.

Alejandro and Jun came round. Alejandro's playing bass in a covers band, gig at the Fleece on Nov 7 at 9pm. Jun's not keen on loud pubs so she'll skip it. I'm going with Matilda. Alejandro also mentioned his birthday's November 9th, two days after the gig, and he's been after a new tuner pedal. Jun is going to Seoul for work from the 12th to the 20th.

Francesca's mum turns 70 on December 4th. Big family lunch planned. Francesca wants to get her a framed print of the village they grew up in, asked if I knew anyone. Her brother Vikram is sorting the restaurant and her sister Neha is doing a cake. Their mum still gardens every day and is a huge fan of Monty Don, so Francesca was also thinking a signed book might work. I should send her the number for that illustrator Esme used.

Amy's son Archie got into the county cricket squad! Training Tuesdays at 6. He's a leg spinner apparently, obsessed with Shane Warne clips. Amy's husband Louis drives him to every session and has basically become the team's unofficial scorer. Their daughter Esme is more into horses, has lessons Saturday mornings at the stables in Wendover. Amy says the weekends are carnage.

Vikram rang. Still at Rolls-Royce in Derby, now leading the test team. His wife Neha is a GP in Belper. They've got a Labrador called Biscuit who ate a sock last week. Their youngest, Rana, has just started at Nottingham doing vet science. Vikram says the house is weirdly quiet. They're thinking of coming down to London in the spring.
Idris is struggling a bit since the redundancy, says the job hunt's grim. Interview with an engineering firm Thursday at 2pm. Must message him Thursday evening to see how it went.

Patrick's really into chess these days, plays online every night, rated about 1600. Wants to enter the Hastings congress over New Year. His wife Matilda thinks it's taken over his life, he's even got their son Oscar playing now. Oscar is eight and already beats me. Patrick's birthday is 1/19, so a nice wooden set or a chess clock would be perfect.

Efua and Esme are moving in together, viewing a flat in Peckham Saturday at 11. Esme's mum is lending them the deposit. Efua works at the Horniman as a curator and Esme's a junior doctor at King's, so they want somewhere between the two. Efua's birthday is 7/4, which she says is cursed because Americans hijack it. Remind me to send them the number of my old letting agent.
Neha's birthday 8/21. Loves Ottolenghi, has every book except Comfort. Note for August.

Rana is a midwife at the Royal Free, lives in Kentish Town. Her husband's Lebanese, does something in shipping. Two boys, both at the primary on Fortess Road. Her mum lives with them half the year and goes back to Beirut for the winter. Rana runs a lot, did the London half in March, and is thinking about a full marathon.
Pick up the dry cleaning tomorrow morning before 10, and book the car in for its MOT. October 28 latest.
Met Ann's new partner Victor Fischer at the quiz. Nice guy. He's a lecturer in medieval history, plays in a ceilidh band on the fiddle. They're off to Edinburgh for a week from the 15th.
Chloe said Louis is nervous about his driving test Friday at 8:40 in the morning. Third attempt. Remind me to text him Thursday night.
Sana Ibrahim — goes by Sunny at work — just got promoted to head of science. Starts the new role after half term. She's into bouldering, goes to the wall every Sunday.
Ahmed's dad died last month. Funeral was in Lahore so Ahmed flew out for two weeks, back now. He seemed quiet. I should check in with him next week.
Petra's daughter Matilda is obsessed with Taylor Swift, has tickets for Wembley next June 21st. Birthday's coming up May 14, so anything Eras-related would be a hit.
Gift ideas: Jun likes matcha and anything Studio Ghibli. Abdi wants a new Arsenal away shirt. Kerry's been eyeing up a Kindle.
Siddharth plays cricket for a Sunday league side in Harrow, opening bat. He's also a massive Liverpool fan, which Kavya hates. They live in Pinner with their two kids and his parents.

Oscar's running the Berlin marathon on 9/27. Been training since March, did 20 miles last Sunday morning. He's raising money for the stroke charity because of his grandad. Sponsor him before the race and send a good luck message the day before.
Jess's birthday was yesterday and I forgot. Need to get her a card and some nice yarn, and ring her this weekend to apologise.
Quick one: Deepa had her wisdom teeth out on Monday at 9am. Face like a hamster. Ask how she's doing Friday.
Alfie Morris from next door is starting at Manchester uni in a couple of weeks, studying physics. His mum's dreading the empty house. He's leaving on September 20th, early, around 7am.
Victor collects fountain pens. Has about forty. His favourite is a Pilot something. Christmas idea maybe, a nice ink.
Kavya's pregnant, due in March! Second baby. Feeling rough with morning sickness but otherwise good. Siddharth is over the moon.
Lunch with Esme and her brother Patrick. Patrick lives in Bristol, works as a sound engineer for the Old Vic. Esme's still nursing at Southmead, nights mostly. Their parents are in Cornwall.
Archie's birthday is April 9. He's into Lego Technic and Formula 1, supports McLaren. Amy said the big Technic Lando car is on his list.
Francesca and Idris are getting married! Engaged last weekend in the Lake District. Wedding probably summer 2027. Send them a card this week.
Aleksander's into birdwatching, spent the summer counting terns on the Farne Islands. He works for the RSPB in Newcastle now. His partner Jess is still in Hebden.
Efua's nervous about her viva on November 18 at 10am. Five years of PhD on this. Must text her good luck that morning, and maybe take her for a drink after.
Neha's grandmother is in hospital after a fall, she's driving to Leicester tomorrow morning. Neha sounded shattered.
Booked my eye test for Wednesday at 4:15. Also renew the passport before the Lisbon trip on 12/10.
Rana said her eldest, Idris, has made the under 12s football team. Plays left back. First match Saturday at 10 against Highgate.
Isaac and his girlfriend Kerry are hosting a Halloween party on the 31st from 8. Fancy dress compulsory. I'm doing a Ghostbusters costume with Jun.
Patrick's dog Rolo went missing on Sunday night, turned up Tuesday at a farm two miles away. Patrick is massively relieved. Ask him how Rolo's settling back in.

Chat with Amy at the school gate. She runs a little Etsy shop selling embroidered tea towels, mostly birds and botanicals. Her husband's a firefighter, does four on four off. They live on Beech Road, the house with the yellow door.
Ann's book club is doing Wolf Hall in November. She's already on the second one. Loves anything Tudor, big Hilary Mantel fan.

Long catch up with Deepa and Kerry at the pub. Deepa's left the NHS and is retraining as a ceramics teacher, first term at the art college. Kerry's thinking about going part time to look after their mum, who's got early dementia. They're both a bit wrung out. Kerry's birthday is July 30th and she's said she wants nothing, but she did mention a spa day twice. Need to ring Kerry next week to check in, and maybe sort the spa voucher with Deepa.
Vikram's 40th is March 6. Neha's planning a surprise do on the Saturday after, the 8th at 7pm at the curry house in Belper. He's into real ale and model railways.
Matilda the cat had her op on Friday, all fine. Well, Petra's cat — I keep forgetting the cat and the kid share a name. Petra was in bits beforehand.
Abdi's sister Kerry is getting married in Accra on 2/14. Abdi's flying out the week before. He's best man and terrified of the speech.
Didn't do much today, cleaned the bathroom, watched the Grand Prix.
Siddharth Gupta from work — Sid — is off on paternity leave from Monday. Twins arrived October 17th at 3am! Need to chip in for the collection and sign the card by Friday.

Chloe plays the cello in an amateur orchestra, concert on December 6 at 7:30 in St Mary's. Her husband Ahmed isn't musical at all, he does the tea and biscuits. Their son Louis is learning violin. I'm going to the concert with Ann.
Alejandro Reyes's mum's surgery got moved again, now the 3rd at 8am. He's taking her in. Alejandro is really stressed, he's had no sleep. Call him that evening.
Jun's into bouldering and Japanese whisky. Lives in Deptford, works as a UX designer for a bank. Grew up in Osaka, moved here at 19.

Archie's grandad Uncle Patrick (everyone calls him Paddy) is turning 80 on the 23rd at 1pm lunch at the golf club. Amy wants everyone to bring a photo for a memory book. Dig out the ones from the wedding.
Esme has started a pottery course Tuesday evenings. Already made a wonky mug for her mum. She's thinking of getting a wheel for the spare room.
Victor and Ann's housewarming was lovely. New place is in Morningside, three floors, garden with a plum tree. Should drop off that bottle of wine I promised them.

Isaac's leaving do for his old job was Friday. Starts at Deloitte on November 2nd at 9, consultancy, which he's a bit apprehensive about. Text him on the Sunday night before. His mum Mrs Costa sent me a lovely thank you card for helping with the move.
Sana mentioned her son Abdi is doing his grade 5 piano exam on 6/3 at 11:20 in the morning. He's practising an hour a day. She says he's fine about it, she's the nervous one.

Ann rang this morning. Her nephew Aleksander is visiting from Kraków on November 14th and staying till the 21st. He's a huge Lech Poznań fan and wants to see a proper English match, so she's trying to get Fulham tickets for the Saturday at 3. I said I'd ask Isaac about spares. Aleksander's also into board games, Catan obsessive.
